package demo

import scala.collection.mutable

sealed trait Shape
final case class Circle(r: Double) extends Shape
case object Empty extends Shape

object Modern:
  given Ordering[Circle] = Ordering.by(_.r)
  extension (s: String) def shout: String = s.toUpperCase + "!"
  enum Color:
    case Red, Green
  def area(s: Shape): Double = s match
    case Circle(r) => math.Pi * r * r
    case Empty     => 0.0
  def main(args: Array[String]): Unit =
    val m = mutable.Map.empty[String, Int]
    for i <- 1 to 3 if i % 2 == 1 do m(i.toString) = i
    println(s"${"x".shout} ${m.values.sum}")
